results.title: Meta reaches $17 billion settlement with states, including Arkansas, in landmark trial over teen social media addiction
results.description: Meta has agreed to pay $17 billion and add child-safety measures to its Facebook and Instagram platforms to end a landmark trial over teen social media addiction and settle claims filed by 47 states, state attorneys general announced Wednesday.

results.title: Google Integrates Gemini AI to Generate Video Ads from Text Briefs in Asset Studio
results.description: Google has integrated its Gemini Omni multimodal model into Google Ads' Asset Studio, enabling advertisers to generate multi-format campaign-ready videos from text briefs, brand guidelines, and existing assets for Demand Gen, Performance Max, and YouTube campaigns. This significantly expands AI-driven creative tools while preserving human oversight.
